children: US annual CPI inflation rose to 3.7% in September, exceeding the 3.6% forecast due to surging energy costs. Core CPI increased 2.6%. The data raised market expectations for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike, causing stock futures to decline and bond yields to rise.

Wall Street traded sharply lower as hotter-than-expected US inflation data reignited interest-rate concerns, overshadowing the latest round of bank earnings. The Dow fell 0.3%, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq lost 1% and 1.5%, respectively, as investors reassessed the likelihood of a Federal Reserve rate pause. Higher energy prices pushed September inflation above forecasts, weighing on market sentiment..

Foreign institutional investors sold equities worth ₹1,857 crore, while India's domestic institutional investors bought ₹2,670 crore as the domestic market ended lower on Wednesday, with the Sensex falling 252 points and the Nifty declining 99 points.

Reliance Industries' subsidiary Jio Platforms filed its RHP for an IPO opening on October 21, 2026. The issue comprises a fresh issue of up to 27 crore shares with proceeds used to repay RJIL borrowings, alongside specific reservations for RIL shareholders and employees.

Crude oil stays above $105 per barrel amid Strait of Hormuz supply disruptions and West Asia tensions, while coal futures trade near three-year highs as expensive LNG drives demand for cheaper power generation alternatives.

title: Market Pulse: Key triggers to watch before the October 15 trading session
